exposure: Radiomic features extracted from axial MR images
Radiomic features extracted from sagittal MR images
cohort: The study included 101 pregnant patients with prenatally suspected placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) who underwent MR imaging.
finding: Radiomics features extracted from axial and sagittal MR image planes showed excellent agreement and similar diagnostic performance in predicting the need for hysterectomy in patients with suspected PAS.
